# nguyenvanlamm.github.io

> Projects by nguyenvanlamm.

- [Quarterbloom](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/quarterbloom-site/llms.txt): a calm rotation puzzle made from Vietnamese cement tiles
- [Coin Cubby](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/coin-cubby-site/llms.txt): a coin sort and merge puzzle for iPhone, coming soon
- [Nightwall](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/nightwall-site/llms.txt): a one-tap stealth ninja climbing game for iPhone, coming soon
- [Lowtide Locks](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/lowtide-locks-site/llms.txt): a calm isometric mirror puzzle for iPhone, coming soon
- [Haboob Run](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/haboob-run-site/llms.txt): a top-down arcade road game for iPhone where you refuel by drafting, coming soon
- [Tiptoe Tabby](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tiptoe-tabby-site/llms.txt): a calm cat balance puzzle for iPhone, walking on knitting needles over a wet floor, coming soon
- [Brinestack](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/brinestack-site/llms.txt): a tactical dive game for iPhone where you restack towed decks to meet sea creatures at every height, coming soon
- [Hadal Relay](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/hadal-relay-site/llms.txt): a side-scrolling deep-sea shooter for iPhone and iPad where every failed dive comes back as a relay that fights beside you, coming soon
- [Snowpack Hop](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/snowpack-hop-site/llms.txt): a one-tap fox platformer for iPhone where every critter you stomp becomes a snow block you climb, coming soon
- [Nibblume](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/nibblume-site/llms.txt): a lanternfish game for iPhone where your glow lures prey and shows you to red-eyed hunters, coming soon
- [Chiselturn](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/chiselturn-site/llms.txt): a calm turntable puzzle for iPhone where you turn a block of coloured stone and carve it one chisel at a time, coming soon
- [Ochrecut](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/ochrecut-site/llms.txt): a calm iPhone puzzle where you dig clay so mineral pigment pours like sand into matching glazed pots, coming soon
- [Beamfork](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/beamfork-site/llms.txt): a calm light-and-mirror puzzle for iPhone, coming soon
- [Slipchute](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/slipchute-site/llms.txt): a calm sorting puzzle for iPhone where one swipe tilts the tray and every parcel slides toward its own chute, coming soon
- [Skepfield](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/skepfield-site/llms.txt): a calm logic puzzle for iPhone where you place one straw beehive in every plot of a patchwork farm and numbered stones count the hives around them, coming soon
- [Topsy Larder](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/topsy-larder-site/llms.txt): a calm jar-sorting puzzle for iPhone where you pour fruit preserves between jam jars and turn jars upside down in brass cradles, coming soon
- [Plasmatide](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/plasmatide-site/llms.txt): an iPhone game inside a blood vessel where you swipe drifting plasma drops and spend them on immune cells to stop germs before they reach the heart, coming soon
- [Folioscape](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/folioscape-site/llms.txt): a calm bookshelf picture puzzle for iPhone where you pull books from packed shelves so their spines complete a hidden picture, coming soon
- [Keyturn Keep](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/keyturn-keep-site/llms.txt): a reverse-siege game for iPhone where you slide brass keys along a quilt's seams and wind-up tin toys turn around to fight for your pillow fort, coming soon
- [Jutwood](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/jutwood-site/llms.txt): a balance game for iPhone where beavers stack sawn planks out over a river and nothing gets cut off, so the reach depends on keeping the weight over what lies below, coming soon
- [Inchwright](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/inchwright-site/llms.txt): a physics puzzle for iPhone where you build an inchworm a tiny cart from twigs, acorns and seed pods and rebuild it at every stopover for the leg ahead, coming soon
- [Kite Weather](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/kite-weather-site/llms.txt): a kite puzzle for iPhone where you draw strings through kites of one colour and the wind turns to follow your string's last step, so the whole field drifts with it, coming soon
- [Tintwig](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tintwig-site/llms.txt): a calm colour puzzle for iPhone where you move chameleon families between the branches of a great tree and pale hatchlings take the colour of the family they join, coming soon
- [Washi Turn](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/washi-turn-site/llms.txt): a match-3 puzzle for iPhone played with two-sided origami paper, where every swap turns both sheets over so you line up the colour under the folded corner, coming soon
- [Nounsmith](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/nounsmith-site/llms.txt): a word-riddle book for iPhone where you drag a word into the picture and it becomes real, or drop a letter on a word to respell it, coming soon
- [Popcorn Pigeons](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/popcorn-pigeons-site/llms.txt): a turn-based rooftop puzzle for iPhone where every step drops a popcorn kernel and the pigeons follow the trail, so you lead them into coops or into each other on the way home, coming soon
- [Tumbletub](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tumbletub-site/llms.txt): a calm physics puzzle for iPhone where you place numbered fizz balls on bath toys, press Fizz!, and the foam pushes every toy into the water, coming soon
- [Tunes on a String](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/tunes-on-a-string-site/llms.txt): a calm music puzzle for iPhone where you take geometric pieces off a hanging mobile in the order of a public-domain melody, and each finished phrase brings in another instrument, coming soon
- [Propworm](https://nguyenvanlamm.github.io/propworm-site/llms.txt): a toy-theatre puzzle for iPhone where you unpin coloured wing nuts from painted stage flats into matching tins while a woodworm steps through the set on every tap, knocking nuts out or boring holes, coming soon
